grammar_focus: 一般过去时(规则/不规则动词·否定·疑问)· be动词过去式 · lend vs borrow
scene: 去意大利度假 · 拖到最后一天买了37张明信片却一张没写

grammar_card.title: 说过去发生的事(一般过去时)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说"已经发生过、结束了"的事。下面全用本课句子举例。

rows: 规则动词:一般 +ed;e结尾 +d;辅音+y→ied;重读闭音节末单辅音双写+ed
不规则动词:要单独记(go→went / buy→bought / get→got / make→made / read→read)
Last summer I went to Italy.(go→went)
否定:didn't + 动词原形(动词要变回原形)
I didn't send any cards.(不是 didn't sent)
疑问:Did + 主语 + 动词原形?
Did you go out last night?

specialRules.rule: 时间状语 last summer / yesterday / … ago / on the last day 前面不加介词(不能说 in last summer)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How many cards did the writer send?

passage: Postcards always spoil my vacations. Last summer I went to Italy. I visited a lot of museums and sat in public parks. The museums were free, and the weather was warm. A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian, and then he lent me a book. I read a few lines, but I didn't understand a word. Every day I thought about the postcards, but I didn't send any. My vacation passed quickly. On the last day I made a big decision. I got up early and bought thirty-seven postcards. I spent the whole day in my room, but I didn't write a single card!
